title: Frontiers: Generative AI and Personalized Video Advertisements
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment, not DiD. One row per user (gen_ai_df.csv, 4,992 rows); users are randomly assigned to AI-generated personalized video, generic video, or personalized image ads. Table 2 and Figure 7 (GenAI-VideoAds.ipynb) regress ad_click on treat_bin (AI-Video vs one baseline arm) with or without female, spend bucket and state controls, overall and by sub-condition (Upsell/Revisit/Switch). No panel, no adoption timing.
design_notes: R notebook GenAI-VideoAds.ipynb, fixest::feols cross-sectional regressions.
data_files_note: README: 1/3 random sample of the experiment data; state anonymized; past spend bucketed into 4 categories.
data_provenance_note: One-third random sample of the original user-level data, with spend bucketed.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract (no article text). RCT; not a DiD design.
